	# the property is set to the default value (effectively, the property is removed
	# from the alarm object)

	logger = system.util.getLogger('configurator.bindingeditor')
	logger.debug('no binding button pressed; prop name= ' + propName)
		
	payload = {'propName':propName,'propVal':'','noBinding':1}

	logger = system.util.getLogger('configurator.bindingeditor')

def browseTagSimple(path):
		"""
		Loads the tags, folders, UDT instances, or providers found in 
			the path, and utilizes the information returned from
			system.tag.browse() to create the list of items.
			
		Args:
			path: The root path to be browsed.
			
		Returns:
			List of items to display in the tag tree.
		"""
		results = system.tag.browse(path).getResults()
		
		tags = []
		
		for result in results:
			if result["name"] != "_types_":
				if str(result["tagType"]) in ["Folder", "UdtInstance", "Provider"]:
					tag = {'label': result["name"], 'expanded':True, 'data': {'folder':result["fullPath"], "hasChildren":result["hasChildren"]}, "items":[]}
					
					if result["hasChildren"]:
						nestedResults = system.tag.browse(result['fullPath']).getResults()
						nestedTags = []
						for nestedResult in nestedResults:
							# do not want to load UDT definitions
							if nestedResult["name"] != "_types_":
								if str(nestedResult["tagType"]) in ["Folder","UdtInstance"]:
									nestedTag = {'label': nestedResult["name"], 'expanded': False, 'data': {'folder':nestedResult["fullPath"], "hasChildren":nestedResult["hasChildren"]}, "items":[]}
									if nestedResult['hasChildren']:
										# if folder/UDT instance has children, append fake item so that it appears that the tree item has children
										nestedTag['items'].append({"label":"Fake Item","expanded":False,"data":{"hasChildren":False},"items":[]})
									nestedTags.append(nestedTag)
								else:
									nestedTags.append({'label': nestedResult["name"], 'data': {'tag': nestedResult["fullPath"], "hasChildren":nestedResult["hasChildren"]}, 'items': [], 'expanded': False})
						tag['items'] = nestedTags
					
					tags.append(tag)
				else:
					tags.append({'label': result["name"], 'data': {'tag': result["fullPath"], "hasChildren":result["hasChildren"]}, 'items': [], 'expanded': False})
	
		return tags
	
	def browseTags(path,tagPath,tagProvider):		
		"""
		Loads the tags, folders, UDT instances, or providers found in 
			the path, and utilizes the information returned from
			system.tag.browse() to create the list of items. If the
			tag exists, then will attempt to expand the folders/UDT
			instances in order to select this tag, and will update
			the tree's selection to show the tag selected.
			
		Args:
			path: The root path to be browsed.
			tagPath: The path of the tag to select in the tree.
			tagProvider: The provider that contains the tag to
				select in the tree.
			
		Returns:
			List of items to display in the tag tree.
		"""
		# initializing selection and selectionData variables
		selection = ['']
		selectionData = [{"itemPath": '',"value": {"hasChildren": False,"tag": tagProvider + tagPath}}]
		
		results = system.tag.browse(path).getResults()
		
		tags = []
		
		# the tree component utilizes an 'itemPath' property for selecting items;
		# for example, if the first tag provider was selected, and if the second 
		# item (tag, folder, or udt instance) in the provider was a folder that 
		# was expanded, and if the third item in the folder was a tag that was 
		# selected, then the item path would be 0/1/2 (0 because first tag 
		# provider, 1 because second item, 2 because third item); so, throughout 
		# the below code, we keep track of the item index by utilzing the 
		# itemPathIndex variable; when we have found an item that is a part of 
		# the full tagPath (provider or folder or tag), we can update the itemPath 
		# string by using the itemPathIndex
		itemPath = ''
		itemPathIndex = 0
		pathLookingFor = tagProvider
		tagPathPartIndex = 0
		tagPathParts = tagPath.split('/')
		
		for result in results:
			if result["name"] != "_types_":
				if str(result["tagType"]) in ["Folder", "UdtInstance", "Provider"]:
					tag = {'label': result["name"], 'expanded':True, 'data': {'folder':result["fullPath"], "hasChildren":result["hasChildren"]}, "items":[]}
					
					# the first 'browse level' ('' as root path) contains a list of tag providers;
					# to start, pathLookingFor is only the tag provider of the tag
					if str(result["fullPath"]) == pathLookingFor:
						# found tag provider, updating the itemPath
						itemPath = itemPath + str(itemPathIndex) + '/'
						# updating the pathLookingFor by adding the next 'piece' of the path
						# to it; for example, if tag path was [default]test/test1/tag, then
						# pathLookingFor starts out as [default], then, after the below line,
						# pathLookingFor will now be [default]test
						pathLookingFor = pathLookingFor + tagPathParts[tagPathPartIndex]
						# increment tagPathPartIndex so that (from the above example) once
						# '[default]test' folder is found later in this script, the
						# pathLookingFor can be updated to '[default]test/test1'
						tagPathPartIndex = tagPathPartIndex + 1
						# reset the itemPathIndex for the next 'level' (folder or udt instance
						# or tag)
						itemPathIndex = 0
					
					# for each tag provider, calls system.tag.browse to get a list of items
					# to display (folders, udt instances, or tags); one of the items in the
					# list will be the next 'piece' of the tag path ('piece' could be a folder,
					# udt instance, or the tag)			
					if result["hasChildren"]:
						nestedResults = system.tag.browse(result['fullPath']).getResults()
						nestedTags = []
						for nestedResult in nestedResults:
							# do not want to load UDT definitions
							if nestedResult["name"] != "_types_":
								if str(nestedResult["tagType"]) in ["Folder","UdtInstance"]:
									# item is either Folder or UdtInstance
									nestedTag = {'label': nestedResult["name"], 'expanded': False, 'data': {'folder':nestedResult["fullPath"], "hasChildren":nestedResult["hasChildren"]}, "items":[]}
									
									if str(nestedResult["fullPath"]) == pathLookingFor:
										# found first folder/UDT instance that is a part of the selected tag path;
										# updating the itemPath
										itemPath = itemPath + str(itemPathIndex) + '/'
										# moving to the next 'piece' of the tag path, which could be the
										# tag, or a folder, or a udt instance
										pathLookingFor = pathLookingFor + '/' + tagPathParts[tagPathPartIndex]
										tagPathPartIndex = tagPathPartIndex + 1
										
										# because this folder contains (or eventually contains, via other
										# folders and/or udt instances) the tag, set 'expanded' to true
										nestedTag['expanded'] = True
										
										# need to browse this path to continue searching for the tag
										pathToBrowse = nestedResult['fullPath']
										
										# localNestedTag starts off being equal to the current 'tag level'
										localNestedTag = nestedTag
										
										# as the below while loop gets deeper into the tag structure, this
										# object gets updated such that it represents the current 'tag level'
										updateLocalNested = {}
										
										# count iterations of below loop
										count = 0
										
										while tagPathPartIndex < len(tagPathParts) + 1:
											# keep browsing until we have the tag selected
											
											selectedTags = []
											
											itemPathIndex = 0
											
											# if updateLocalNested length is greater than 0, then we
											# know that we have at least found the first 'tag level'
											# (after the 'tag levels' that we already have);
											# updateLocalNested should now be pointing at the next
											# 'tag level', so update localNestedTag so that it is
											# also pointing at the next 'tag level'
											if len(updateLocalNested) > 0:
												localNestedTag = updateLocalNested
											
											selectedTagResults = system.tag.browse(pathToBrowse).getResults()
											for selectedTagResult in selectedTagResults:
												if selectedTagResult["name"] != "_types":
													if str(selectedTagResult["tagType"]) in ["Folder","UdtInstance"]:
														selectedTag = {'label': selectedTagResult["name"], 'expanded': False, 'data': {'folder':selectedTagResult["fullPath"], "hasChildren":selectedTagResult["hasChildren"]}, "items":[]}
														
														if str(selectedTagResult["fullPath"]) == pathLookingFor:
															# found the next folder/UDT instance that is a part of the selected tag path;
															# updating itemPath, pathLookingFor (so that it now contains the next 'tag
															# level'), tagPathPartIndex, pathToBrowse (the path for the next 'tag level'),
															# and updateLocalNested (so that it is pointing at the current 'tag level')
															itemPath = itemPath + str(itemPathIndex) + '/'
															pathLookingFor = pathLookingFor + '/' + tagPathParts[tagPathPartIndex]
															tagPathPartIndex = tagPathPartIndex + 1
															selectedTag['expanded'] = True
															pathToBrowse = selectedTagResult['fullPath']
															updateLocalNested = selectedTag
														else:
															if selectedTagResult['hasChildren']:
																# it is a folder or udt instance that is not in the tag path, so append a Fake item and then add to
																# nestedTag
																selectedTag['items'].append({"label":"Fake Item","expanded":False,"data":{"hasChildren":False},"items":[]})
													else:
														if str(selectedTagResult["fullPath"]) == pathLookingFor:
															# the tag in the selected tag path has been found;
															# add the final itemPathIndex to itemPath; set
															# the selection and selectionData props; increment
															# tagPathPartIndex so that the while loop will finish
															itemPath = itemPath + str(itemPathIndex)
															selection[0] = itemPath
															selectionData[0]['itemPath'] = itemPath
															
															tagPathPartIndex = tagPathPartIndex + 1
														
														selectedTag = {'label': selectedTagResult["name"], 'data': {'tag': selectedTagResult["fullPath"], "hasChildren":selectedTagResult["hasChildren"]}, 'items': [], 'expanded': False}
												
												selectedTags.append(selectedTag)
												itemPathIndex = itemPathIndex + 1
												
											localNestedTag['items'] = selectedTags
											
											count = count + 1
											
											# loop execution hit limit, break
											if count > 200:
												return -1
															
									else:
										if nestedResult['hasChildren']:
											# if folder or UDT instance have children, append fake item so that it appears that the tree item has children
											nestedTag['items'].append({"label":"Fake Item","expanded":False,"data":{"hasChildren":False},"items":[]})
									nestedTags.append(nestedTag)
								else:
									# the tag has been found
									if str(nestedResult["fullPath"]) == pathLookingFor:
										itemPath = itemPath + str(itemPathIndex)
										selection[0] = itemPath
										selectionData[0]['itemPath'] = itemPath
								
									nestedTags.append({'label': nestedResult["name"], 'data': {'tag': nestedResult["fullPath"], "hasChildren":nestedResult["hasChildren"]}, 'items': [], 'expanded': False})
									
								if tagPathPartIndex > 0:
									itemPathIndex = itemPathIndex + 1
							
						tag['items'] = nestedTags
					
					tags.append(tag)
					
					# this increment of itemPathIndex is only for the tag provider
					itemPathIndex = itemPathIndex + 1
				
				else:
					tags.append({'label': result["name"], 'data': {'tag': result["fullPath"], "hasChildren":result["hasChildren"]}, 'items': [], 'expanded': False})
		
		return (tags,selection,selectionData)
		
	def updateSelection(selection,selectionData):
		"""
		Updates the selection and selectionData properties of the tag
			tree.
			
		Args:
			selection: The selection string.
			selectionData: The selectionData list.
		"""
		self.props.selection = selection
		self.props.selectionData = selectionData
		
	alarmProp = self.view.params.alarmProp
	propName = value
	
	if len(alarmProp.keys()) > 0:
		if alarmProp[propName]['bindType'] == 'Tag':
			tagPath = alarmProp[propName]['value']
			
			if tagPath != '':
				# tag binding already exists, try to automatically select this tag
				# when loading the tree
				
				# utilizing Timer to update tree selection slightly after the tree
				# has loaded all of its items
				
				from threading import Timer
				
				if ']' in tagPath:
					# tag provider in path
					
					if '[~]' in tagPath:
						# utilize the currTag param (tag whose alarms are being edited)
						# to figure out the tag provider that contains the tag that is
						# being referenced in this binding
						currTag = self.view.params.currTag
						
						# extract provider from the path of the 'tag that is being
						# edited', and then change [~] to [providerName] in the
						# tagPath variable, so that the rest of the script can try
						# to find the tag to select
						provider = currTag.split(']')[0].replace('[','')
						tagPath = tagPath.replace('[~]','[' + provider + ']')
					
					if not system.tag.exists(tagPath):
						updateSelection([],[])
						# if tag does not exist, then return default tag tree
						return browseTagSimple('')
					else:
						# if tag does exist, then try to select it
						
						# tag provider in path, extract provider from path
						tagProvider = tagPath.split(']')[0] + ']'
						
						result = browseTags('',tagPath.split(']')[1],tagProvider)
						
						if result == -1:
							updateSelection([],[])
							return browseTagSimple('')
						else:
							tags = result[0]
							Timer(0.4,updateSelection,[result[1],result[2]]).start()
				else:
					# tag provider not in path, try to figure out which
					# provider this tag belongs to
					
					tagProviderNotFound = True
					
					# browse the root to get list of tagProviders
					tagProviders = system.tag.browse('')
				
					for result in tagProviders:
						provider = str(result['fullPath'])
						if system.tag.exists(provider + tagPath):
							tagProviderNotFound = False
							tagProvider = provider
							break
							
					if tagProviderNotFound == False:
						# tag provider was found, so, when caling browseTags, pass in tagPath
						# and tagProvider to have this tag be automatically selected
						result = browseTags('',tagPath,tagProvider)
						
						if result == -1:
							updateSelection([],[])
							return browseTagSimple('')
						else:
							tags = result[0]
							Timer(0.4,updateSelection,[result[1],result[2]]).start()
					else:
						# tag provider not found, so, will not be able to automatically have
						# the tag selected
						tags = browseTagSimple('')
						updateSelection([],[])
			else:
				# tag path is empty (even though property has a tag binding); will not be able
				# to automatically have the tag selected
				tags = browseTagSimple('')
				updateSelection([],[])
					
			return tags
		else:
			# property does not have a tag binding; has an expression binding
			updateSelection([],[])
			return browseTagSimple('')
	else:
		# property does not have a binding
		updateSelection([],[])
		return browseTagSimple('')

config.script:
# send message to propChange to save the binding (or removal of binding)
	# in tagConfig
	
	binding = self.view.params.alarmProp
	propName = self.view.params.propName
	
	if len(binding) > 0:
		# binding is not empty
		propVal = binding[self.view.params.propName]
	else:
		# binding is empty (user pressed 'no binding', or prop had no binding to
		# start and user did not create a tag or expression binding)
		propVal = ''
	
	payload = {'propName':propName,'propVal':propVal}
	
	# with built-in alarm editor, when removing a binding on a non-associated data
	# property, the property is removed from the alarm (the property will now have
	# the default property value until the user changes it), whereas when removing
	# a binding on an associated data property, the property is not removed from
	# the alarm (the property still exists, and it is equal to ''); so, if the len()
	# of binding is 0, meaning that there is no binding, and if the property is not
	# an associated data property, then we pass 'noBinding' in the payload to
	# propChange message handler, and propChange removes the property from the alarm
	if propName in ['name','enabled','priority','timestampSource',
			'label','displayPath','ackMode','notes','ackNotesReqd',
			'shelvingAllowed','mode','setpointA','inclusiveA','anyChange',
			'setpointB','inclusiveB','bitPosition','bitOnZero','isActive',
			'deadband','deadbandMode','timeOnDelaySeconds','timeOffDelaySeconds',
			'ackPipeline','activePipeline','clearPipeline','voip_customMessage',
			'CustomEmailMessage','CustomEmailSubject','CustomSmsMessage'] and len(binding) == 0:
			
			payload['noBinding'] = 1
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage("propChange",payload=payload,scope="page")
		
	logger = system.util.getLogger('configurator.bindingeditor')
	logger.debug('binding saved; binding = ' + str(dict(self.view.params.alarmProp)))
	
	# to ensure that the tag tree starts clean if the binding editor is
	# opened again later, refresh the binding on props.items, clear
	# out the selection
	self.parent.parent.getChild("Main Cont").getChild("Tree").refreshBinding('props.items')
	self.parent.parent.getChild("Main Cont").getChild("Tree").props.selection = []
	self.parent.parent.getChild("Main Cont").getChild("Tree").props.selectionData = []
	
	# call updateBindingEditor, which will clear out alarmProp param,
	# which will make the display of this view False
	payload = {'name':'','prop':{},'displayName':''}
				
	system.perspective.sendMessage("updateBindingEditor", payload = payload, scope = "page")

# closing the binding editor
		
	logger = system.util.getLogger('configurator.bindingeditor')
	logger.debug('binding cancelled; binding = ' + str(dict(self.view.params.alarmProp)))
	
	# to ensure that the tag tree starts clean if the binding editor
	# is opened again later, refresh the binding on props.items, clear
	# out the selection
	
	self.parent.parent.getChild("Main Cont").getChild("Tree").refreshBinding('props.items')
	self.parent.parent.getChild("Main Cont").getChild("Tree").props.selection = []
	self.parent.parent.getChild("Main Cont").getChild("Tree").props.selectionData = []
	
	payload = {'name':'','prop':{},'displayName':''}
	
	# call updateBindingEditor, which will clear out alarmProp param,
	# which will make the display of this view False
			
	system.perspective.sendMessage("updateBindingEditor", payload = payload, scope = "page")
